reviewed_by: Claude review of two-way subagent messaging
reason: Supervisors and subagents could only exchange the task and the final report, and several failures (settle exceptions, unposted reports, goal continuation) only reached the diagnostics log. This adds a durable ChatSubagentMessage entity and ChatSubagent.rounds; message_subagent / subagent.message (working child reads it before its next step, a paused question takes it as the answer, a finished child runs another round); message_parent (optionally waiting for a reply) and read_parent_messages on every subagent turn, which therefore always routes tools; delivery to a waiting parent (waits end on messages and open questions), a working provider parent (Core-added list_subagents step with no budget), a running Codex/Claude harness (steer), Grok (updates on subagent tool results) and an idle parent (posted subagent_message plus next-prompt context); questions to a parent that cannot answer are closed with the reason. Reports carry error, last_step, tool_failures and undelivered_messages; settle exceptions fail the subagent with the cause; goal continuation failures pause the goal. test_chat_subagents.py and test_harness_provider_subagents.py carry 10 new tests (two-way messages mid-work, question answered by a waiting parent, question to an idle parent, new round, failure details, bookkeeping failure, unread messages on stop, harness question/answer, harness steer, harness next-turn delivery). The other files cover the provider tool loop, turn resume, goals, harness runtime, tool catalog/suggestion spec sets, storage deletion and CRUD registration. Verified live on a throwaway Core against OpenRouter (Claude Haiku 4.5, gpt-4.1-mini), Codex and Grok.
exclusions: No UI, native or Playwright change: the list API only gains additive fields (rounds, question) and new posted messages use metadata.kind subagent_message, which the transcript renders as a plain assistant message. test_browser_companion.py is left out because it needs a real Chromium and does not touch subagents.
